answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The ember is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
